messages:
Anya: quick heads up — saw 3 nodes in us-west-2-3090-pool flapping with Xid 13 & occasional ECC logs. Put them into drain, but want to run a deterministic post-repair burn-in/soak before returning to service. Proposed plan below, need owners + telemetry checklist.
Sam: got it. can you paste dmesg snippets? are they showing ECC corrected vs uncorrected?
Anya: uncorrected ECC in two cases, sample dmesg: 
```
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, pid 0, graphics fault
[12345.678902] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```
Sam: hmm, GPU dropped off bus. Could be flaky PCI seat or power. Did we see thermal spikes? temps were fine (75C).
Frank: I ran `gpu-diag --memtest` on one node, memtest failed intermittently at pass 3. suspect flaky card. we should do a 72h soak with alternating memory/compute stressed workloads and power-cycle between runs.
Anya: proposed process:
1. quarantine node + label `quarantine/burnin`
2. run 72h soak: mix of `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 24h`, constant generation load (llama-runner/mini) to exercise attention cache, and memtester loops
3. every 6h run `nvidia-diag --kv-check` and capture `dmesg | tail -100` and `sensors`
4. thermal cycle: power off 5m every 12h
5. acceptance: no Xid/ECC uncorrected for 48h after final thermal cycle and memtester passes 5 iterations
Sam: I'm fine owning one node. notes on commands:
```
# sample burnin loop
for i in $(seq 1 3); do
  stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 8h &
  ./gpu-burngen --model small --tokens 50000 &
  memtester 4G 100
  wait
  sleep 300
  nvidia-diag --kv-check > /var/log/burnin/diag-$i.log
done
```
infra-bot: Node gpu-3090-23 moved to DRAIN by Anya at 2026-03-18T15:02:10Z :white_check_mark:
Devon: We should collect perf counters too (pcie error counters, reties). add `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=pcie.link.errors.*` to telemetry.
Maria: also add watchdog that auto-quarantines if Xid 13 repeats within 1 hour of boot. we had regression where a node returned too early.
Anya: timeline: start burn-in tonight 21:00 PDT. will update infra ticket INF-4123 with logs. If node passes, we'll stage back to canary pool for 24h under reduced traffic before full return.
Sam: cost note: 72h soak at 100% GPU is ~9 GPU-hours of test time per node = billable infra but worth it to avoid flakies. we should prioritize nodes with multiple fail signatures earlier.
Frank: if memtester keeps failing, get replacement card and run the same soak in lab for 120h. don't reintroduce partial passes.
Anya: action items:
- Sam: run soak on gpu-3090-23 starting 21:00
- Frank: start extended 120h on spare lab card tomorrow if memtester unstable
- Maria: add quarantine watchdog rule to infra-automation
- Devon: add perf counters to burnin telemetry
